architecture_decision.objective: Deliver Frantic bounty 79: read current CRM state from an operator-selected source, reconcile a transcript, execute grounded allowlisted updates through a real transport, and independently read back the same state. Publish and verify the exact package under the contributor identity.
architecture_decision.operator_value: An operator receives verified CRM changes or a clear no-op, review, conflict, or refusal outcome, with each field traced to the current record and transcript evidence.

identity.rationale: CRM cleanup is the requested existing capability. Keep the package name and publish the contributor version as kkebi50-svg/crm-cleanup; do not create an adjacent first-party name.

knowledge_contract.purpose: Teach bounded transcript-to-CRM reconciliation, field evidence, uncertainty, source ownership, mutation authority, concurrency, and independently verified finality.
evidence_required: Current bounded CRM snapshot read at runtime using data.read_events from the operator-selected logical source and aggregate.
Transcript and schema allowlist with field meanings and record identity.
For every proposed field: record id, prior value, exact quote, rationale, confidence and ambiguity status.
Native append result and independent native readback from the same source.
decision_logic: Read one latest complete CRM snapshot event; reject absent, malformed, duplicate-id or non-snapshot sources.
Agent judgment extracts takeaways and proposed changes; quoted evidence alone is not semantic entailment and confidence must be justified.
Deterministic CRM policy enforces record identity, allowlist, verbatim evidence, unchanged-value no-op, unique field targets, and minimum confidence.
Any ambiguous, contradictory or insufficiently supported change blocks the mutation and returns needs_review.
Apply a complete new CRM snapshot with data.append_event using the observed source version and a caller-supplied stable operation key, then read back and compare all records.
No-op and refused branches execute no append. A version conflict never claims a write. A readback failure remains unverified, not successful.
stop_conditions: Missing transcript, missing bound source, unavailable scope, absent CRM snapshot, unsupported schema or oversized control input.
Uncertain record matching, low confidence, contradictory evidence, unknown field, concurrent modification or mismatched readback.
Windows deterministic worker cannot install its resource limits in the current environment; successful harness evidence requires an unchanged supported runtime environment.
recovery: Supply the missing bounded evidence or correct source binding, retaining the transcript and unresolved findings.
After a conflict re-read current source state and reconcile again; do not blindly retry stale updates.
After uncertain execution, read back the existing source and use the same operation identity rather than duplicating the write.
Resolve the runtime environment failure before publishing or claiming harness success.

required_behaviors.outcome: Explain transcript evidence, field policy, source snapshot contract, operator-selected transport and honest finality.
Read the current bounded CRM snapshot event and retain native source, version and digest evidence.
Extract takeaways and grounded candidate updates with confidence and record identity; report uncertainty explicitly.
Validate semantic evidence relationships, compute exact before/after CRM records, reject ambiguous updates, and compare independently read-back records.
required_behaviors.domain_module_justification: CRM field matching, unchanged-value detection, evidence quote membership, conflicting targets, confidence policy and full-record comparison are deterministic domain computation. Native data operations do not own these semantics; the module uses no filesystem, network, hashing or process APIs.

required_behaviors.outcome: Route no-op/review/refusal without effects, otherwise execute the exact planned state transition and readback.
Append the CRM state transition with native version comparison, idempotency and source-bound receipt evidence.
Independently read the latest CRM event after execution from the same operator-selected source.

The operator-selected data-source adapter executes bounded reads and appends; native SQLite provides the explicitly synthetic CRM transport for validation. No provider simulator is implemented in the skill.

routes: CRM cleanup owns CRM policy. data-store owns canonical source read and conditional append semantics; the operator selects the bound adapter. Native SQLite is an explicitly synthetic mock CRM transport for dogfood, never a live customer CRM claim. The result preserves transcript evidence, record identity, before/after values, version, operation identity and native receipts; a proposal is unattempted until the append executes, and a native append is unverified until the independent readback matches.

The canonical registry CLI separately publishes and reads back the exact locally validated kkebi50-svg/crm-cleanup version. No registry HTTP, credential handling or publication behavior is embedded in the skill.

preservation_obligations: Preserve the existing crm-cleanup identity and its evidence, allowlist, no-op and refusal semantics while replacing proposal-only default finality with the required executed-and-verified workflow.
Keep all changes inside skills/crm-cleanup; preserve unrelated products and runtime protections.

Use typed small control inputs: transcript maximum 16000 characters, at most 50 CRM records and 50 proposed changes; durable state stays in native source storage rather than an accumulating input history.
Retain native readiness coverage with lead-enrichment and lead-router as selection confusors and a composed journey preserving upstream transcript evidence.
Public version, GitHub PR head, registry digest, harness, clean install and dogfood evidence must agree. Do not publish until execution validation can run successfully.
No private customer data, secret files, paid model calls or payment destination changes.

trigger_requests: Update this CRM from the call transcript and verify the changes.
direct_use.default_outcome: Read current CRM records, apply grounded allowed changes once and return before/after readback, or an explicit no-op/review/refusal.
routine_host_work: Select the operator-owned source and provide a bounded transcript and CRM field schema.
direct_use.runx_boundary: Source-bound evidence, scoped mutation, optimistic concurrency, idempotency and independent readback are governed by native capabilities.
direct_use.terminal_result: Takeaways, field_updates and write_result with before/after and actual effect status.
direct_use.blocker_behavior: Return precise missing or ambiguous evidence and leave CRM state unchanged.
direct_use.native_escape: Return the bounded transcript context, source identity, takeaways and unresolved field findings so the operator can resolve uncertainty without losing evidence.

accepted_inputs: An existing bounded transcript and CRM schema from an upstream call-processing step.
An operator-selected source handle and stable operation key.
chain_use.result: A source-bound CRM cleanup outcome with takeaways, field_updates, before/after records and readback status.
reused_evidence: Upstream transcript and field schema, without re-transcription.
must_not_repeat: Do not re-transcribe the upstream call.
Do not append any event when the CRM already has the requested values.

proof_plan.name: inspect-complete-contract
proof_plan.expected: Native inspection reports complete typed public inputs/outputs, all four readiness facts true and no semantic diagnostics.

proof_plan.name: selection-crm-versus-leads
proof_plan.expected: Select crm-cleanup for transcript-driven CRM updates, distinguishing lead-enrichment and lead-router.

proof_plan.name: default-read-write-readback
proof_plan.expected: Default runner reads a seeded source, executes a changed field once, independently reads back the same source and returns exact before/after records.

proof_plan.name: upstream-transcript-reuse
proof_plan.expected: Consume upstream transcript/schema evidence without re-transcription; an already-matching CRM emits no append.

proof_plan.name: no-op-uncertainty-refusal-conflict
proof_plan.expected: Unchanged fields, unsupported fields, absent quote, low confidence, ambiguous record and concurrency conflict never claim verified mutation.

proof_plan.name: scope-and-readback
proof_plan.expected: Withheld scope and mismatched readback stop accurately through production native owners.

proof_plan.name: published-dogfood
proof_plan.expected: After a green local harness, publish exact version and digest, clean-install it, run separate synthetic CRM transport read/write/readback dogfood, verify production receipts and hosted registry harness, and link raw files at the public PR head.
